name: Eating Shellfish
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes between clean and unclean foods, specifically in regard to aquatic creatures. God commands that only those with fins and scales are permissible to eat, while all others in the waters, including shellfish, are declared an abomination. This dietary law, given to Moses and the Israelites, reflects God's holiness and His design for His people’s obedience. Although after the Flood God declared that every moving thing could be food, the Mosaic law later sets specific boundaries that His covenant people were to observe.
